rounds.title: ROUND 1 · EMERGENCY INBOX
rounds.rule: A message is URGENT if its score reaches the threshold. Never miss a real emergency. Allow at most 1 false alarm.
rounds.fa: A real emergency was missed. Lower the threshold.
rounds.fb: Too many false alarms. Raise the threshold a little.

rounds.title: ROUND 2 · SPAM FOLDER
rounds.rule: Now a message is BLOCKED if its score reaches the threshold. Never block real mail. Let at most 1 spam through.
rounds.fa: Too much spam got through. Lower the threshold.
rounds.fb: Real mail got blocked. Raise the threshold or lower the caps weight.
